title: No Enchantment Exclusivity
description: No Enchantment Exclusivity lets you use all enchantments together.
body:
###  This Datapack lets you use all enchantments together!

## **Changes:**
- All protection types can be used at the same time
- Riptide and Channeling can be used together
- Bane of Arthropods, Smite and Sharpness can be used together
- Density and Breach can be used together
- Depth Strider and Frost Walker can be used together
- Infinity and Mending can be used together
- Multishot and Piercing can be used together
- Fortune and Silk Touch can be used together
- You can now get multiple enchantments in the enchanting table
